question.worked_solution:
The given repeating decimal can be expressed as

$$
\begin{aligned}0.15\overset{―}{3} & =0.153\,33… \\  & =0.15+0.003+0.000\,3+0.000\,03+… \\  & =0.15+(\frac{3}{1\,000}+\frac{3}{10\,000}+\frac{3}{100\,000}+…).\end{aligned}
$$

The series in the parentheses is a geometric series with first term ${a}_{1}=\frac{3}{1\,000}$ and common ratio $r=\frac{1}{10}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}0.15\overset{―}{3} & =0.15+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1} \\  & =0.15+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{3}{1\,000}{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =0.15+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{3}{100}(\frac{1}{10}){(\frac{1}{10})}^{n-1} \\  & =0.15+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }0.03{(\frac{1}{10})}^{n}.\end{aligned}
$$
